fusions.name: Turn the Herd
fusions.desc: Turns your shield across a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage and pushing enemies 2.5 tiles back. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4.

fusions.name: Bellwether Blow
fusions.desc: Strikes one enemy within 5 tiles with your shield, dealing 30 damage. When it lands, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Barn Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and every ally near you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Coat
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
